about_the_game:
A Roguelite RPG Where Time is Your Enemy

In Die in Time, dice are more than chance, they are fragments, pulling possible futures into reality with every roll. Enter The Vault, a realm where time moves differently than your own world. Death won’t save you here. Every life, every choice, and every roll brings you closer to uncovering the secrets that lay within.

Key Features

⏳A Time-Twisted Roguelite
Enter through The Gate and venture into The Vault. If you die, you return, as if nothing ever happened. Only through exploring the many areas deep within, vanquishing strong foes, and discovering long lost artifacts will you uncover the secrets that lay within.

🎲 Dice-Driven Combat
Each die is a fragment of time, controlling different possibilities.

  • Collect over 200+ dice and equipment

  • Each die face is an attack, spell, or ability

  • Spend Luck to reroll and bend chance in your favor, if you roll a Miss or an attack you don't want

⚔️ Construct Your Build, Your Way

  • Equip weapons, armor, and relics with unique synergies

  • Unlock and master different build combinations

  • Discover powerful boons and bargain with entities outside time itself

🌀 Those Who Lay Below

Deep within The Vault lies the shadow of an ancient race. Little is known of them, but their presence lingers in every corner: in the crumbling shrines, in the strange relics, and in the very dice you wield.

Their designs, their secrets, their mistakes - all remain locked inside The Vault, waiting for those bold enough to uncover them.

🤝 Mibbin, Your Companion Outside Time

Not all journeys into The Vault are made alone. Waiting faithfully outside the Gate is Mibbin: a loyal, goblin-like friend with a knack for remembering what the world forgets. To him, your deaths and returns look instantaneous, but he knows something isn’t right.

Mibbin believes his old friend Caelan disappeared into The Vault, and he hopes you’ll be the one to bring him back. Between runs, Mibbin acts as your guide:

  • Unlock new boons and upgrades with the Memory Fragments you recover.

  • Piece together stories of The Vault through his conversations.

  • Share in his curiosity, worry, and humor as the mystery deepens.

🏛️ Explore The Vault
Choose your path through branching rooms:

  • Battle Rooms: Test your dice and strategy against creatures of The Vault

  • Shops: Barter with Burrow & Co., scavengers who profit from digging up lost equipment buried over time

  • Boons: Trade Shards with The Weaver for powerful rewards

  • Bargains: Risk everything in trades with The Bargainer

  • Shrines: Enchant and merge relics or dice

  • Treasure Rooms: loot rewards… or face Mimics waiting to devour you

  • Archive: gather information from long lost journal entries from those who came before, and those who are still there

Planned Content

  • ⚔️ Multiple biomes (10 planned) each with their own enemies, bosses, and lore

  • 🎲 More Dice collections to discover and complete

  • 📜 Journal entries that slowly reveal the truth of The Vault

  • 🧩 Metaprogression system where Memory Fragments unlock new starting boons to start your runs how you want.

About Free Rain Studios

  • The studio is currently only comprised of one person (me, the one writing this, I hope to change that in the future).

  • Die In Time is made with the feedback and input of many family and friends, and are considered part of the team.

  • Thank you for supporting our game!
detailed_description:
Demo Coming Soon!

Die In Time is currently in development. We hope to have a free demo that includes a fully playable build of the first in-game area, Forsaken Dungeon.

This demo will be used to gather feedback, and to let people try the game before release. Expect this demo to be available in the coming weeks.
